component.name: KeyDis
component.summary: Native Redis and Valkey client for KDE

description.p: KeyDis is a native Qt 6 and KDE Frameworks 6 desktop client for Redis and Valkey, built for Linux and KDE Plasma.
It provides SCAN-based key browsing, core data type viewers and editors, a command line, and a KDE-native desktop experience.
KeyDis is not affiliated with Redis Ltd., the Valkey project, or KDE e.V.

Standalone workbench: Dashboard, namespace tree, DB switching, core type editing, profiles with KWallet, server tools, memory analysis, DUMP/RESTORE transfer, Stream groups, RedisJSON paths, Sentinel/SSH connectivity, Chinese translation.
